statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0104 · 由单块质量把组内差分嵌入中心窗
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0104 · Embed within-cell differences into the central window

brief.zh: 把 [n/2,5n/8) 分为 B 个长度 H 的块，BH=n/8。反射块起点为 n−(n/2+jH+H−1)。块总权乘积除以 H 至少为 H/4；块外项非负。
brief.en: Partition [n/2,5n/8) into B cells of H points, with BH=n/8. Reverse each reflected cell starting at n−(n/2+jH+H−1). Each product of block sums divided by H is at least H/4. All omitted terms are nonnegative.
